text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes without blowing out edges, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality—even a 0.5% gain matters when every fraction counts. The trade-off is extra compute time: depth-aware upscaling is slower than standard methods, but the fidelity gain outweighs the delay.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under its depth maps. Instead, test RealVisXL’s face-focused upscaler first; it locks fidelity but avoids Anthropic’s pipeline dependency. Run a blind A/B on 100 faces—if RealVisXL wins by ≥0.5% on face clarity, adopt it; else, revisit depth-aware.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add RealVisXL’s face-preserving upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline now. Faces are EXCAVA’s weakest link—blur kills clarity, and RealVisXL fixes that without depth-map guesswork. The trade-off is slower throughput: RealVisXL’s face focus adds 15-20% render time, but a 0.5%+ face clarity gain outweighs it. Run a blind A/B on 100 faces; if it beats InstantX by ≥0.5%, lock it in.

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL locks us into Anthropic’s pipeline—if they change their model or pricing, we’re stuck. Test InstantX-ComfyUI’s face-focused upscaler instead; it’s open-source, avoids pipeline dependency, and runs locally. Blind A/B on 100 faces settles it: if InstantX’s face clarity beats RealVisXL by ≥0.5% at lower compute cost, adopt it.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Test InstantX-ComfyUI’s face-focused upscaler against RealVisXL in a blind A/B on 100 faces—winner adopted; Torque owns the test and artifact delivery by EOD.
